title: trifolium resupinatum subsp. tomentosum
intro: Trifolium resupinatum subsp. tomentosum, commonly known as Persian clover or hairy clover, is a subspecies of clover plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to improve digestion, reduce inflammation, and lower blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Trifolium resupinatum subsp. tomentosum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which make it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
